mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening labor market, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST decreases > 10% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO increases > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during a monetary tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1), it signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS decreases > 100,000 in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO decreases > 2% QoQ.
